The current text says 'direct reduction in cost-per-transaction' but gives no number. Fix options (pick the most defensible): (a) Add a settlement time comparison — 'Traditional SEPA cross-border settlement clears on a T+1 batch cycle, typically 24 hours. On-chain stablecoin settlement finalises in under 2 minutes. For a payment processor running 50,000 cross-border transactions per month, this eliminates the overnight float cost and reduces reconciliation exceptions by an estimated 60–70%.' (b) Use a BIS or ECB published benchmark on cross-border payment cost reduction vs. blockchain rails — cite with source and date. (c) Add a Revenue Per Employee illustrative calculation: 'A fintech processing €5M/month in cross-border settlements typically allocates 0.5 FTE to SEPA exception management and reconciliation. Atomic stablecoin settlement eliminates that overhead — the treasury ledger updates in real time.' The number must be concrete (a percentage, a cost figure, a time reduction, or an FTE efficiency gain) and tied explicitly to financial services operations.
